user.title: Range Thermostat
user.description: Hold a room between two temperatures by flipping a single-setpoint minisplit between heat and cool.

data_description.climate_entity: The climate entity this thermostat will command.
data_description.sensor_entity: The external sensor that governs the room temperature. The minisplit's own sensor is never used.

abort.already_configured: This minisplit already has a range thermostat.

data.single_command: Combine mode and setpoint into one command

data_description.deadband: How far outside the band the room must drift before a mode change is triggered. Applied symmetrically to both edges.
data_description.min_cycle_duration: Minimum time between mode changes. Setpoint adjustments within the same mode are never delayed.
data_description.overshoot: Pulls the commanded setpoint toward the middle of the band to buy coast time. Clamped at the midpoint.
data_description.sensor_timeout: How long the temperature sensor may go without an update before the thermostat stops issuing commands.
data_description.resend_interval: Re-send the current command this often to recover from dropped IR transmissions. 0 disables it.
data_description.single_command: Send a mode change as a single climate.set_temperature call carrying hvac_mode, instead of two separate calls. Only enable this if the underlying integration honours hvac_mode inside set_temperature - ESPHome does, and folds it into one IR frame, but most integrations silently ignore it and would never change mode.
